dsDescriptionValue.value: In order to ensure the long-term and efficient use of grape genetic resources in Germany and to guarantee their availability, the Deutsche Genbank Reben was founded in 2010 as a gene bank network. The Deutsche Genbank Reben consists of vine conservation facilities and is thus an essential instrument for securing vine genetic resources in Germany.
